objective: Minimum vertical extent over every rigid print-axis direction of each complete manufacturing STL surface.
method: Seeded upper bound plus independent whole-sphere numerical branch-and-bound; no edge-pair enumeration.
oriented_export_cleanup: Exact-zero float32-collapse facets may be removed after coincident-vertex welding; every original valid source face is used in the height certificate. Export topology and surviving face order are explicitly audited.

certificate.arithmetic: long double with explicit roundoff allowance; numerical certificate, not exact rational/interval proof

cases.candidate_search_scope: Convex-hull face normals, a spherical seed lattice and local numerical minimization propose candidates. No edge-pair enumeration is used.
cases.global_certificate_method: Independent spherical branch-and-bound covers all eight octants. Lower bounds are minima of actual source-vertex difference dot products over an enclosing spherical cap, plus a conservative box-diagonal Lipschitz bound. Upper bounds are checked over all source STL vertices.
cases.transformation: p_print = R @ p_source + t, followed only by audited float32 export-collapse cleanup when required
cases.polarity_tie_break: Prefer larger affine-dimensional bottom contact, then more source vertices; not a stability certification.
cases.XY_twist_rule: Projection of source X, or source Y near parallelism; XY translation centres the model for float32 precision, not XY packing optimization.
cases.certificate_scope: Full original valid manufacturing STL before binary export quantization/cleanup; actual exported Z extent is separately rechecked.
